lessons.title: Time Speed Distance Basics
lessons.concept: Distance = Speed × Time. Speed = Distance/Time. Time = Distance/Speed. km/h to m/s: multiply by 5/18.
lessons.worked_example: 90 km/h = 90 × 5/18 = 25 m/s. Train crosses bridge in 36 s → length+speed = 25×36 = 900 m.

lessons.title: Relative Speed
lessons.concept: Same direction: relative speed = difference. Opposite direction: relative speed = sum. Trains crossing: distance = sum of lengths.
lessons.formula: Same dir: |v1−v2|; Opposite dir: v1+v2; Train+bridge: L_train + L_bridge
lessons.worked_example: Train A 90 km/h (25 m/s) crosses bridge in 36 s → L+bridge = 900 m. Train B 100 m shorter, 45 km/h (12.5 m/s) → t = 800/12.5 = 64 s.
mistakes: Adding instead of subtracting for same direction
Forgetting train length in crossing problems

A car travels 60 km at 40 km/h and 60 km at 60 km/h. Average speed?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 120. Total time = 60/40 + 60/60 = 1.5 + 1 = 2.5 h. Avg = 120/2.5 = 48 km/h.

questions.explanation: Relative speed (opposite directions) = 50 + 30 = 80 km/h. Time = 200 / 80 = 2.5 hours.

questions.question: A person walks at 4 km/h instead of 5 km/h and reaches work 12 minutes late. Distance =
questions.explanation: Slower speed takes longer: time diff = d/4 - d/5 = d/20 hours. Setting d/20 = 12 min = 0.2 h gives d = 4 km. Check: 4 km at 4 km/h = 60 min, at 5 km/h = 48 min, difference = 12 min late.

questions.question: A boat travels 24 km downstream in 3 hours and back upstream in 6 hours. Speed in still water =
questions.explanation: Downstream = 8 km/h, upstream = 4 km/h. Still water = (8 + 4)/2 = 6 km/h (stream = (8 - 4)/2 = 2 km/h).

questions.question: A train 200 m long crosses a 300 m platform in 25 seconds. Its speed =
questions.explanation: The train must clear its own length plus the platform: distance = 200 + 300 = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s = 20 * 18/5 = 72 km/h.

questions.explanation: Stream = (downstream - upstream)/2 = (14 - 10)/2 = 2 km/h (boat in still water = 12 km/h).

questions.question: A person travels from A to B at 30 km/h and returns at 20 km/h. Average speed for the whole journey =
questions.explanation: For equal distances, average speed is the harmonic mean: 2*30*20/(30+20) = 1200/50 = 24 km/h. Taking the arithmetic mean (25 km/h) is the classic trap.
